facts.rationale: Updates the stale input.held_inputs spelling to the pinned canonical field and preserves the exact zero-health boundary and cross-file result lifetime.
facts.value: Resolves the supplied HSD_GObj to Fighter and reads input.held_buttons[0] and shield_health. If the held-button mask contains HSD_PAD_LR and shield_health is at least zero, it forwards the unchanged object to ftCo_800928CC and returns true; otherwise it returns false without dispatch. The common dispatcher selects Yoshi's GuardHold entry. At Yoshi roll-animation completion, the caller first zeros gr_vel and consumes true by returning before presentation cleanup and neutral completion. On false, it performs that fallback and subsequently calls ftYs_Init_8012B8A4.
